meta.source: NASA Five Millennium Canon of Solar and Lunar Eclipses (Espenak & Meeus), catalogues for 2001-2100
meta.credit: Eclipse predictions by Fred Espenak and Jean Meeus, NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center
meta.license: NASA GSFC eclipse predictions are US Government work in the public domain; the site asks that the authors be credited.
meta.timeScale: Times are the Terrestrial Dynamical Time (TD) of greatest eclipse, exactly as tabulated. TD runs ahead of UT by the dT column (about 75 s this century), so treat these as within a couple of minutes of civil time, not to the second.
meta.note: A committed mirror of a published catalogue, not a computed prediction. We do not compute eclipse paths or local circumstances; the greatest-eclipse point is the tabulated one.
